use_case_summary: Large engineering org (monorepo, ~1.2k devs). Primary objective: replace ad-hoc IDE copilot stack with a centralized Redwood-backed copilot to reduce latency for streaming completions and control model versions per team. Needs per-seat cost visibility and token/unit economics for budgeting across teams. Wants automatic fallback to smaller/cheaper variants when high throughput bursts occur.
technical_requirements:
- Streaming latency SLO: median <50ms for inline completions, p95 <120ms under typical dev batching
- Throughput: 50 concurrent interactive seats during business hours; burst to 300 parallel requests for repo-wide refactor events
- Model constraints: must pin specific model versions per team; ability to test new model on canary group
- Caching: prefix/KV caching for common completions, shared snippet cache across orgs
- Quantization: willing to accept 4-bit/8-bit quantized models if deterministic behavior preserved; require regression tests against golden prompts
- Observability: token-level cost per route, streaming trace, per-seat cost attribution
- Security: VPC private control plane, KMS integration, retention controls configurable to 30/90/365 days
